narrative.details: My real mission was to weaken the Scarlet Crusade's outlying forces and then infiltrate Hearthglen to gauge their numbers. I'm still in no shape to do it on my own, so perhaps I could ask you to aid me again, adventurer? From what information I gathered before being discovered, the Crusade has two important members that are the backbone of their forces outside the town: Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen. Kill them, and we're making progress. They should be along Hearthglen Pass outside the town proper.
narrative.objectives: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you, adventurer. You've been more help than I could have hoped for. The air here just seems to suck my will. I feel tired, and I can tell I'm not getting any better the longer I'm here.

I'm not really sure how I'm going to infiltrate Hearthglen itself and report on how strong the Scarlet Crusade's presence is.

But that's another matter, before you leave, here, take this... as payment for your help. Thank you again.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found them yet, adventurer? With the two of them taken care of, I can proceed to enter Hearthglen to take a closer look at their setup. I can't do it without your help. Please, find Radley and Durgen for me.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 56 to 58, 18,000 XP in all.
